text:
maya: Quick design review — putting a short thread here on the compare table + filters UX. want everyone's hot takes before i lock the mocks. figma: https://figma.redwood/abcd (updates in frame 'compare-v6')

sam: Skimming — main thing i noticed is the badge semantics are overloaded. the green 'perf' badge currently means ‘fast on hosted’ but visually it's the same for 'verified' and 'cost-optimized'. we should separate color + icon. :thinking_face:

elena: +1. Suggestion: split badges into two tiers — status badges (verified, deprecated) and perf badges (latency/cost). different shapes? e.g., pill vs square. also filters need a "show only pinned versions" toggle. currently pinning is per-model not per-version and that's confusing.

kevin: on pinning: product asks for users to be able to pin a model+version combo (so their routes don't silently change). can we change the pin icon tooltip to "Pin version to this workspace" instead of just "Pin"? tiny tweak but helps.

rui: Accessibility nit: when a user pins/unpins we need a screenreader announcement. propose adding `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` with copy: "Version 2.1 pinned to workspace". Also keyboard flow — the pin should be focusable inside the compare row, not only in overflow menu.

maya: good call. for copy i'd prefer "Pin version to workspace" -> shorter: "Pin version" and show workspace name in announcement. e.g., `aria-live`: "Pinned v2.1 to Marketing workspace".

sam: Agree with rui on keyboard. Also the filter chips area: when focus moves into filters, NVDA currently reads the whole chip list which is noisy. We should add `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the filter group and move the collapsible list into a region with `aria-hidden` toggles.

elena: Visual: contrast on the small perf badge numbers (like "13ms") fails AA on dark mode. can we bump the background to #0f1724 or switch the text to 14px semi-bold? quick check: `color: #e6eef8` on `#071028` is borderline.

kevin: For filter semantics: make the "Compare selected models" button disabled until >1 model selected. Right now it stays active and triggers an empty compare modal which is confusing. Also persist selected filters across page reloads when user has a workspace-level preference.

maya: UX trade: persisting filters by default could surprise users. maybe add a small toast when persistent filters are enabled: "Filter preferences saved for this workspace" with an undo. Thoughts?

rui: thumbs up on the toast. Also automation: when a model is pinned, the compare view should surface the pinned version at the top of the list and mark it with a stronger visual affordance (2px outline + badge). keyboard users can tab to "Jump to pinned" button.

sam: microcopy idea for badges: instead of raw numbers show units: "13 ms" -> "13 ms (p95)" and add a tooltip with the test context (seq len, batch). that will reduce support questions.

elena: one more accessibility note: the compare rows are dense — each row has 4 interactive elements. for screen reader users we should expose a composite control per row with a single row-level menu. then allow expanding to access finer controls. less tabbing.

maya: ok action items I hear: 1) split badge types + update color/iconography (sam) 2) pin copy + aria-live announcement (kevin/rui) 3) ensure pin is keyboard-focusable inside row (rui) 4) improve filter chip a11y with aria attributes (sam) 5) increase perf badge contrast & show units/p95 tooltip (elena/sam) 6) persist filters behind opt-in + toast (kevin/maya) 7) row-level composite control for SR users (elena)

kevin: I'll take 6 and help spec the toast microcopy.

sam: i'll prototype badge shapes + the filter aria attributes.

elena: i'll run contrast tests and mock the row-level composite.

rui: I'll add the `aria-live` snippets and keyboard focus changes to the a11y checklist.

maya: sweet. can we sync and do a quick pass in design crit tomorrow 9:30? if everyone can drop any last comments here before EOD that'd be great. :thumbsup:

design-bot: New comment added to frame 'compare-v6' by maya. Suggested labels: design-review, a11y, copy.

kevin: done — added a short note about undo on the toast and a11y copy samples.

maya: thanks all — closing thread for now, will update Figma and reopen if anything major pops up.
